description: Feuerwehreinsätze in Graz is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by http://www.graz.at/praesidialabteilung. the operations of the Graz fire brigade from 1999 to 2015. Coverage: http://www.graz.at/praesidialabteilung. The portal shows the English title as "Firefighters in Graz" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is http://www.graz.at/praesidialabteilung. Its keywords include verwaltung. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
